title: San Antonio Property Taxes in 2026: The $140,000 Exemption and What You'll Really Pay
seo_title: San Antonio Property Taxes 2026 & the $140,000 Homestead Exemption | Kanye Concierge 360
description: Texas raised the school homestead exemption to $140,000 and the over-65 exemption by $60,000. Here are San Antonio's tax rates by school district and how to file with Bexar Appraisal District.
keywords: how to file homestead exemption Bexar County
hero_alt: San Antonio homes and property taxes
intro: Property taxes are the biggest ongoing cost of owning a home in Texas. Texas voters approved two big changes in November 2025 that cut the school portion of the bill for homeowners.

items: School homestead exemption: raised from $100,000 to $140,000
Over-65 or disabled: an extra $60,000 school exemption, up from $10,000
When: both apply starting with the 2025 tax year
Approved: by Texas voters on November 4, 2025

sections.h2: San Antonio tax rates by school district
paras: Combined 2025 rates inside the City of San Antonio (city, Bexar County, University Health, Alamo Colleges, river authority and school district), before exemptions:
after: School district rates alone (2025): Alamo Heights ISD 0.9572%, North East ISD 0.9822%, Judson ISD 0.9796%, Northside ISD 1.0049%, San Antonio ISD 1.1552%, Medina Valley ISD 1.1527%, Southwest ISD 1.1598%, Harlandale ISD 1.2575%. Some areas add an emergency services or other special district. 2026 rates are being adopted this fall.

items: Boerne (Kendall County, Boerne ISD): about 1.86% combined
New Braunfels in Comal ISD: about 1.79% combined, before any special district

sections.h2: What the new exemption saves, in real numbers
paras: Take a $300,000 home in Northside ISD:
items: Old: $200,000 taxable for school taxes × 1.0049% = about $2,010
Savings on the school portion: about $400 a year

sections.h2: How to file your homestead exemption in Bexar County
items: Where: online at Bexar Appraisal District, or by mail
Attach: a copy of your Texas driver's license or ID showing the home's address
Deadline: April 30 of the tax year
Late: you can still file up to 2 years after the deadline (5 years for disabled veterans)
Bought after January 1: you can get it for the rest of the year if the previous owner didn't have one

faq.q: What is the homestead exemption in Texas for 2026?
faq.a: School districts must exempt $140,000 of a homestead's value. Homeowners 65 and older or disabled get an additional $60,000 school exemption.

faq.q: What is the property tax rate in San Antonio?
faq.a: Combined 2025 rates inside the city run about 2.27% (North East ISD) to 2.44% (San Antonio ISD) before exemptions.

faq.q: When is the deadline to file a homestead exemption in Bexar County?
faq.a: April 30 of the tax year. Late applications are accepted up to 2 years after the deadline, or 5 years for disabled veterans.
